punchline: Three flights, three different causes, one bank balance.
thirty_sec: Falcon 1 failed on its first three flights in 2006, 2007 and 2008, from a fuel leak, an oscillation and leftover thrust. Musk later said the fourth flight was the last money he had for the rocket.
question: In the project you are running now, how many attempts do your money and time actually buy, and what will each one teach you?
key_contrast: Three different mistakes, but a budget draining at the same pace.
